message: Lead reviewed the unresolved Reviewer 1 concurrency question in frozen f68449e. correctAgentWorkingStateAs only checks ledger task/attempt/agent versions. Ordinary tool activity of an already-Working agent updates TUI last-seen but does not necessarily change those canonical versions, so a correction based on old observed versions can still succeed during genuine ongoing work. This appears to violate the task's stale-activity acceptance requirement. Please work with Reviewer 1's pending verdict and add a deterministic concurrent-activity rejection test/appropriate architectural guard before resubmission; avoid merely increasing CAS checks against unchanged fields. Do not merge/deploy.
